name: streaming-tools-site
description: A static directory of open-source streaming tools by worxbend.

scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:e2e
scripts.format: prettier --write index.html assets/*.js assets/*.css scripts/*.mjs tests/*.mjs package.json .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check index.html assets/*.js assets/*.css scripts/*.mjs tests/*.mjs package.json .github/workflows/*.yml
